body: From the pre-registered combined-avoid test (insight:bt-india-combined-avoid-2026), branch 'H1 not supported, H2 supported'. The red flag does not deepen 13-week drift after a miss, so no EXIT escalation. It roughly triples 12-month halving risk (17.6% vs 6.1%; 29% with pledge>50%), so the combination caps the position size and blocks new money, and a balance-sheet deep-dive question is opened. S5-India is not a trigger (no signal). Open question for a future pre-registered test: apply the cap to any red-flag firm regardless of earnings (C halves 15.1%, 2.5x base). Research, not SEBI-registered advice.
title: Decision card: keep PEAD avoid gate unchanged; add survival cap when a bottom-two SUE result coincides with pledge>25% or interest cover<1.5x (no new money / minimum size)
